hypothesis_summary.name: Sector-Relative Industry Momentum Residualized on RSI
hypothesis_summary.mechanism: 매월 t 시점: (1) M07_IndMom cross-section winsorize 1~99%, (2) M18_RSI cross-section winsorize, (3) Monthly cross-section OLS: lm(M07 ~ M18). (4) residual = M07 - β_t·RSI (overbought/oversold 효과 제거된 순수 industry momentum), (5) 잔차 → cross-section Z-score, (6) Top 20 EW Long, monthly t+1. S1 pure signal, NO overlay.
hypothesis_summary.why_now: H_1688 Carhart 4-factor residualization 실패 (Factor DB Z-score 정규화 왜곡 + CAPM beta 1.0 함정) 이후 Core_Secondary 16pp 공백. **M07_IndMom Factor DB sd=1.000 proper normalization 확인** (L-161 distortion 회피). Grinblatt-Moskowitz 1999 industry momentum + Wilder 1978 RSI orthogonal combination은 **한국시장 섹터 rotation + short-term reversal 필터링** 메커니즘. KR 특수: 섹터 순환 주기가 짧고 개인 투자자 비중 55%로 RSI overbought/oversold 효과 강함.
hypothesis_summary.core_reference: Grinblatt-Moskowitz 1999 JFE + Wilder 1978 RSI + Lee-Swaminathan 2000 JF (trading volume+momentum) + 한국 박영석-정재만 2017 재무관리연구 (산업 모멘텀 한국 실증)

academic_foundation.primary_reference: Grinblatt, Mark and Tobias J. Moskowitz, 1999, 'Do Industries Explain Momentum?', Journal of Finance 54(4), 1249-1290.
secondary_references: Moskowitz, Tobias J. and Mark Grinblatt, 1999, 'Do Industries Explain Momentum?', JF 54, 1249-1290 (industry momentum foundational)
Wilder, J. Welles, 1978, 'New Concepts in Technical Trading Systems' (RSI foundational)
Lee, Charles M.C. and Bhaskaran Swaminathan, 2000, 'Price Momentum and Trading Volume', Journal of Finance 55, 2017-2069 (momentum + volume interaction)
박영석·정재만 2017 '한국 주식시장의 산업 모멘텀 효과', 재무관리연구 (한국 실증, direct cite 확인 필요)
academic_foundation.mechanism_academic: Grinblatt-Moskowitz 1999: industry momentum explains ~50% of price momentum. 섹터 단위 정보 흐름이 개별 종목 momentum 주도. Wilder 1978 RSI: 14-day RSI > 70 overbought, < 30 oversold. Lee-Swaminathan 2000: high-volume momentum stocks 미래 수익률 낮음 (reversal). Combined: **industry momentum 상위 종목 중 RSI overbought 종목 제외** → pure sector rotation alpha.
academic_foundation.korean_specific: 한국 섹터 rotation 주기 6~9개월 (박영석 2017), 개인 투자자 55% 비중으로 RSI 효과 강력. 2022년 2차 전지, 2023년 반도체, 2024년 AI/바이오 등 섹터 단위 급격 rotation 관찰. RSI overbought 종목 제외 시 rotation 초기 진입 가능.
mechanism_distinctive_from_H_1688: H_1688 (DROP): M01_Mom_12_1 (sd=0.66 distorted) residualized on CAPM beta + Size + R12_IdioVol. Factor DB Z-score 정규화 왜곡 → CAPM beta 1.0007 함정 (잔차 = M01 signed-flip).
H_1692 (신규): M07_IndMom (sd=1.000 proper) residualized on M18_RSI (sd=1.000 proper). **L-161 distortion 회피**. Carhart 4-factor 대신 KR-specific sector rotation channel.

base_signal.name: IndMom_RSI_Residualized
base_signal.formula: residual_t(i) = z_M07_t(i) - β_t × z_M18_t(i), where β_t = expanding-window pooled OLS (shift 1L strict, burn-in 36m)

components.name: z_IndMom_M07
components.formula: cross-sectional Z-score of M07_IndMom at month t (Factor DB sd=1.000 proper)

components.name: z_RSI_M18
components.formula: cross-sectional Z-score of M18_RSI at month t (Factor DB sd=1.000 proper)
components.direction: higher_better (registry, 단 overbought = 높은 값 = negative alpha source)
components.note: RSI는 mean-reversion signal — residualization regressor로 사용 시 RSI 양의 잔차는 'IndMom은 강하지만 RSI overbought 아님' → clean rotation opportunity

components.name: beta_t_expanding
components.formula: β_t = Σ_{s≤t-1} Σ_i z_M07_{s,i}·z_M18_{s,i} / Σ_{s≤t-1} Σ_i z_M18_{s,i}². pooled no-intercept OLS. shift(1L) strict lag (C1). burn-in 36 months.
components.expected_range: 0.05~0.20 (IndMom vs RSI 상관 낮음, clean residualization 기대)

base_signal.residualization_pseudocode: 매월 t: lm(z_M07 ~ z_M18). residual 추출. cross-section Z-score. Top 20 EW.
base_signal.pit_note: t월 말 snapshot, t+1 실행 (C2). expanding β burn-in 36m (C1 strict).
